description: **Who is actually buying — from the trades themselves.** Per-minute (or 5/15/30/60-minute) aggregates over the raw trade feed for one A-share: buyer- vs seller-initiated volume, large-print counts, true VWAP. The self-verifiable counterpart to `fundflow` (the vendor's own classification) — the two routinely disagree. `buy_ratio` = buy_vol / (buy_vol + sell_vol); ⚠️ Neutral volume is deliberately excluded from the denominator. `vwap` is yuan per share. ⚠️ `big_count` / `big_amount` use a fixed 200,000-yuan-per-print line, meaningless on high-priced names (贵州茅台: 97 of 99 prints in one 5-minute bucket cleared it) — compare a stock with itself only; unrelated to fundflow tiers. ⚠️ `tick_count` counts the prints **we captured** (3-second snapshots), not the exchange's trade count. Omit `date` for the latest day that has data. History starts 2026-05-26; earlier = not covered.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

code.description: Canonical code of one A-share security (e.g. SSE:600519)

date.description: Trading day YYYY-MM-DD (China time). Omit for the latest day that has data.
